reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

questions.prompt: Why is Anna unsure about going to the Halloween party at first?
options: She does not know where the party is.
She has promised to work that night.
questions.evidence: I might go. I might not go. I don’t have a costume. Can you help me?
questions.explanation: Anna在might go / might not go之后明确说明没有服装，并请求朋友帮助。缺服装是这段给出的顾虑；地点和工作安排虽然可能影响参加活动，但本文没有这样说。

spokenEvidence.quote: I might go. I might not go. I don’t have a costume. Can you help me?

questions.prompt: What warning does Genie give Anna?
options: The party may begin too early.
People may refuse to wear costumes.
questions.evidence: Anna, be careful. Things might go wrong.
questions.explanation: Genie说be careful并提醒things might go wrong，表示事情可能出问题。might表达可能性，并没有确定宣告一定失败，也没有具体说聚会会提前或别人不肯穿服装。

spokenEvidence.quote: Anna, be careful. Things might go wrong.

questions.prompt: What subject does Rebecca study? Write ONE WORD.
questions.explanation: Rebecca对所学专业的直接回答是journalism，意思是新闻学。后面说到找一份writing the news的工作，与这个专业相关，但题目要求的是专业词，不是未来职位或毕业时间。

questions.prompt: Why does Rebecca react badly to Anna’s first job prediction?
options: Anna says she has chosen the wrong subject.
The prediction leaves open the possibility that she will not get the job.
Anna says she has already graduated.
answers: The prediction leaves open the possibility that she will not get the job.
questions.evidence: I MIGHT get a job writing the news? I MIGHT! That means I might not. And I'm studying really hard.
questions.explanation: Rebecca抓住might，自己解释为也可能得不到工作，觉得付出的努力没有获得确定回应。Anna并没有说她选错专业或已经毕业。题目考语气带来的反应，不把Anna后来的will保证当成实际就业结果。

spokenEvidence.quote: I MIGHT get a job writing the news? I MIGHT! That means I might not. And I'm studying really hard.

questions.prompt: What does Kaveh plan to do that day?
options: Ask his girlfriend to marry him.
Choose a new name for his band.
answers: Ask his girlfriend to marry him.
questions.evidence: Well, today, I will ask my girlfriend to marry me.
questions.explanation: Kaveh用today和will说明当天的计划，是向女友求婚。能确认的是他打算提出请求，不能据此断定女友已经答应或婚礼一定举办。新闻学属于前一位Rebecca的情况，乐队名称则没有被提到。

spokenEvidence.quote: Well, today, I will ask my girlfriend to marry me.

questions.prompt: How does Genie know a rock-star costume might suit Anna?
options: She has seen Anna perform at the party.
Anna has already bought the same costume.
Anna previously told her that she likes rock music.
answers: Anna previously told her that she likes rock music.
questions.evidence: No. You told me you like rock music.
questions.explanation: Anna以为对方读懂心思，Genie用No否认，再说明信息来自Anna曾说喜欢摇滚乐。因此不是看过她在聚会表演，也不是Anna已经买了同一件服装。这里用明确的对话纠正区分猜测与已给出的信息。

spokenEvidence.quote: No. You told me you like rock music.

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item source comparison; not human or psychometric calibration

blindComparison.scope: Source text only; not an actual listening check, human examiner review or difficulty calibration.
